purpose: A Saphir quotation summarizing the Christ-centered unity of Scripture.

defaults.author: Adolph Saphir
defaults.rightsBasis: 1892 London edition, public domain in the USA. Wording matched to stored OCR; page-scan verification pending.
defaults.reviewNote: Read in the surrounding lecture on the Church of Christ based on the Old Testament. Author's theological summary, not Scripture; use KJV for accompanying Bible text.

entries.title: The Centre Is Christ
entries.text: The Scripture has a centre, and that is Christ. Once we understand this centre we understand everything.
entries.slideText: The Scripture has a centre, and that is Christ. Once we understand this centre we understand everything.
entries.recommendedUse: Introduce a Christ-centered whole-Bible study, biblical-theology lesson, or sermon series.
